open_questions: This is a small local authoring catalog, not a hosted registry or evidence authority.
A new profile over admitted roles requires data/source; a new protocol or effect role still needs an original owner implementation.
Composition roots accept only nodes/edges and explicit child resource maps; individual catalog families do not constitute a universal application-intent compiler.
